description: The context functions read the caller's context: USER and INGROUP the principal, NOW and TODAY the clock, all in UTC, STATE and ID the document the formula runs over (ADR-0040). The functions of the row read what the document keeps of its own life (ADR-0047): when it was created, last changed and entered its state, by whom, the state it came from, and its version. The functions of a state read its events (item 6): when and by whom it first and last entered a state and left it, how often and how long it was there, and who first and last changed it there. NOW is an instant, TODAY a calendar day (ADR-0023).
